algorithm_assessments.signal_summary: Excess-green + HSV mask for canopy coverage per pot image.
algorithm_assessments.why_helpful: Captures leaf area proxy needed for growth and vigor tracking in foggy-light conditions.

algorithm_assessments.signal_summary: Connected-component count over vegetation mask for plant clump estimation.
algorithm_assessments.why_helpful: Helps decide where thinning is needed when multiple seedlings compete in the same pot.

algorithm_assessments.signal_summary: HSV yellow-in-canopy ratio for stress/chlorosis proxy.
algorithm_assessments.why_helpful: Flags nutrient or stress risk early when yellowing increases inside active foliage.

algorithm_assessments.signal_summary: Canopy coverage delta against earliest baseline photo per pot.
algorithm_assessments.why_helpful: Gives directional growth signal and helps estimate survival probability, but currently limited by baseline availability.

algorithm_assessments.signal_summary: Laplacian variance for in-focus image quality gating.
algorithm_assessments.why_helpful: Prevents over-trusting noisy measurements from blurry images by marking rows that need recapture.
